scope: Real local automated checks; ordinary external service calls use test doubles. This does not establish hosted CI or live service availability.

ci_review.airflow_environment: Separate constrained Apache Airflow 3.1.3 installation; no incompatible base optional extra

source_note: Checks ran against committed executable/config source at source_commit. Current uncommitted tracked changes are documentation or evidence only.
review_fixes: Failed quality gate is no longer contradicted by undetermined retraining necessity.
Freshness policies must be finite and positive; missing timestamps remain explicit uncertainties.
HTTP(S) tracking endpoints with embedded credentials, queries or fragments are rejected before evaluation logging.
Airflow diagnostics prioritize structured exceptions after long log preambles and inspect complete returned evidence.
source_tree_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON mapping each sorted tracked source/config path to its file SHA256; roots listed in source_fingerprint_scope
